data.name: Amrat
data.gender_notes: Amrat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amrat is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Amruta’ which means 'nectar of immortality'. According to Hindu mythology, the Gods churned the ocean to obtain Amrita, the elixir of immortality. The name signifies the quest for eternal life and divine blessings. The name Amrat carries the meaning “Nectar of immortality” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amrat usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar of immortality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
